algorithm: Initialize a visited set and a queue.
For each unvisited node, perform a BFS/DFS to mark all reachable nodes.
Each BFS/DFS traversal corresponds to one connected component.
Count the number of such traversals.
constraints: Edges are distinct and 0 <= u < v < n.
No cycles are allowed in the graph.
Graph is connected if all nodes are reachable from any starting node.
inputs: n is an integer >= 1; edges is a list of distinct [u, v] pairs with 0 <= u < v < n.
purpose: Returns the number of connected components in an undirected graph.
